annotations.title: Add a page to a site

description: Adds a new page (e.g. "/about", "/contact") to an existing site, built from html (same importer as create_site_from_html) or composed from sections/content_json in the site's own palette and fonts. Link between pages with href="/about". Respects the plan's page limit; stage:true previews it before it goes live. Free.

content_json.description: Per-section content keyed by section kind, exactly as create_site_from_brief's content_json. Styled with the site's own palette and fonts.

draft_token.description: The draft token returned by draft_create, if you are working on an anonymous draft. Only needed when your client cannot send the x-pagetool-draft-token header.

html.description: Build the page from this HTML (same importer as create_site_from_html). Omit to compose it from sections instead.

name.description: The page name shown in the editor's page list. Defaults to one made from the path ("Contact Us").

path.description: The new page's path, e.g. "/about" or "/contact": lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 19 characters. Link to it with href="/about".

sections.description: Comma-separated section kinds to compose the page from when html is omitted: hero, about, services, features, gallery, testimonials, pricing, faq, hours, contact, cta, footer, menu, map, social, header, products, reviews, gamesList. Defaults to about.

site_key.description: The site to add a page to. Defaults to the caller's current draft site when omitted.

stage.description: true = work on a staged copy instead of the live site: preview it at staged_preview_url, then publish_staged or discard_staged. Omit for a normal (immediately live) edit.
